reviews.author: Albury Higgs
reviews.text: Bill Buckman came to our home on the 4th of July, and we really appreciated his excellent service. He was prompt, professional, and took the time to explain everything clearly. He quickly resolved our issue and made sure everything was working properly before he left. We were especially grateful that he came out on a holiday. Highly recommend Bill for anyone needing HVAC service!

reviews.author: Lise Meinhardt
reviews.text: I am so pleased with the replacement of my heat pump and air exchanger by Jax Heating Contractors. Kevin gave me several options, explaining the benefits of each. The work was done professionally, and the technicians took special care to protect my property as they brought equipment in and out. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Richard Joslin
reviews.text: Austin arrived on time, actively listened to my input on the issue, quickly confirmed the issue and corrected it, and I had a working system in under an hour. Austin was also very personable and professional, and helped me understand the situation. Company pricing was very competitive and reasonable. Next-day onsite with resolution and coolant recharge was done within an hour.

reviews.author: M McCormick
reviews.text: Jermaine Cunningham arrived on time for our routine HVAC service under out Good Friends Membership. He gave us a full report and explained his findings in a manner that was understandable. He gave us some suggestions for efficient usage, etc. Very happy with the service!

reviews.author: Jessy Wilson
reviews.text: Very fast turnaround time. The tech (Jeffrey Owens) arrived earlier than scheduled and notified us in advance of the change in times. He took the time to explain everything clearly and was patient when waiting for final approval to move forward with the work and waiting to gain entry to an office where that attic access was due to active sessions. Worked professionally, quickly and quietly. Would like to request that this technician be assigned to our future service calls if possible. -Thank you Jeffrey!!!

reviews.author: Robert (PennzTube)
reviews.text: Communication was excellent and Bill Buckman was an excellent technician. He explain everything that caused my system to shut-down and made a few maintenance recommendations. He offered the service packages from the company and was very pleasant to work with!

reviews.author: Jessica Owens
reviews.text: On Sunday, our geothermal heating & cooling system stopped working. We called a different vendor and based on our experience, decided to get a 2nd opinion. I remembered using Jacksonville right after we moved here (about 2.5 years ago) and called them yesterday. They were able to get us in this morning. Billy Buckman told me what he suspected the problem was and within an hour he had our system up and running. He was efficient, knowledgeable and literally saved us a ton of money. We were so impressed we bought into one of the maintenance clubs. My only regret is we didn't call them first. Geothermal systems are no joke. I never even heard of them until we bought this house. Billy had decades of expertise in this pretty niche space and can't recommend him and Jacksonville Heating any more highly.

reviews.author: Kim Jones
reviews.text: I had someone staying at my beach house when the AC went out. I called Jacksonville Htg in the afternoon and someone came out to fix my unit that night! The renter stated that the young man that came from the AC company was so nice and so professional. I always get great service and recommend Jacksonville Heating for all your HVAC needs.

reviews.author: Mark W.
reviews.text: Was amazed at the quick response I received from the company! The service technician was professional and polite when dealing with my concerns about my a/c not working! I will be getting a year round service contract with Jacksonville Heating Contractors to take care of a very important and needed system for my home !

reviews.author: Paul McC.
reviews.text: HVAC tech Bill Buckman was an Ace! Professional and personable, he quickly assessed my old system, recommended a cost efficient solution and performed the repair. Good bye hot and humid, it's back to the comfort zone!

reviews.author: Claw Test1
reviews.text: Billy Buckman did a good job and got my HVAC running again to keep my family comfortable in this heat wave. However, its been over a week and I haven't heard back from anyone at their office about replacing the part that's leaking coolant. Pretty upsetting as they installed the unit brand new about 2 years ago. It's a Trane unit.

reviews.author: Leah Stankiewicz
reviews.text: Kevin took the time to thoroughly assess our current system and understand our home’s specific needs before providing an estimate, which we really appreciated. The installation team was professional, knowledgeable, and kept us informed throughout the entire process. Everything went smoothly from start to finish. We’re extremely satisfied and highly recommend Jacksonville Heating Contractors

reviews.author: Vincent Palmieri
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with James from Trent Heating. From start to finish he was incredibly professional, highly informative, and a genuinely likeable guy. He took the time to explain everything clearly . We will definitely be using Trent Heating again in the future!

reviews.author: Ryan Turnewitsch
reviews.text: This is the second time that Billy Buckman from Jacksonville Heating has come to our home to service our air conditioner. The service has been exceptional, accurate, efficient, and he has fixed the problem both times. I have been very impressed at his diagnostic ability and cannot recommend him enough. He is an excellent technician and his service is top-notch. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: J Rhodes
reviews.text: Exceptional service and education about the products supported. During the service visit Mr. Buckman was very attentive to my questions and his expertise and knowledge of my overall geothermal set up was very impressive. Walked me through validation of the issues experienced and resolved the issue. He employ d necessary caution and awareness of the equipment and overall effectively corrected the issue, and at a very reasonable and fair price. Thank you Billy Buckman and Sam for pointing me in the right direction for my issues here! All the best and definitely will not hesitate in contacting this team when future HVAC issues arise! Thank you!

reviews.author: Judy Currier

reviews.author: Tim Washburn

reviews.author: pts pts
reviews.text: UPDATE: We had a high humidity situation that needed investigation. Bill Buckman was our tech, and he was patient, Professional, and Super Detailed. Absolutely Top Notch; from the Evaluation and heat Load calculations done by Kevin Harvey- to the installation of new condenser & air handler inside. The company took great care of us. Kevin not only comes & evaluates: but then shows you the best options for your house & explains all the differences. Then- works with you to engineer the best setup. Installation went Great, Lawrence & Gio worked their tails off to get it installed professionally: Kevin stopped in to review everything & oversee: absolutely A+++++!!!!!!

I cannot recommend them enough!

reviews.author: diane knipple
reviews.text: Billy Buckman was the tech who came to do my HVAC system maintenance. He was extremely knowledgeable about the system and a personable and pleasant person to talk with.

reviews.author: Beth Schub
reviews.text: Billy was on time and quickly located our problem. He was professional and stayed until the system was up and working again.

reviews.author: Tamika Michelle
reviews.text: The tech Bill Buckman was overall nice. However, he discussed A LOT of possible expensive repairs, but at the same time told me he wasn't sure. The whole experience was overwhelming and quite frustrating because we still don't know what is causing the issue for sure. UPDATE: Second visit from tech Bill Buckman. Bill came back to our home to put refrigerant in our unit. During the first home visit on 9/26/2025 he stated the unit would only need 2 pounds of refrigerant. However, this visit on 9/30/2025 he states the unit needs 4 pounds. My husband asked why he couldn't do a leak check? Bill stated it was too costly. So instead of fixing the issue he decided to just add more refrigerant stating the cost to repair was not worth it. I thought that decision should have been made by the homeowner not the technician. Might I add we have a protection plan through Duke Energy that would have covered some of the cost of the repair if not all. 0/10 would NEVER recommend this company.

reviews.author: Jonathan Brearey
reviews.text: Tech Billy Buckman was superb. He knows what he’s doing and gets it done without delay. He found the problem (bad compressor and fouled system) and took care of recommending to the company and me what had to be done. All’s working fine now. Thanks

reviews.author: William annick
reviews.text: Great company, with great service. Pricing is in line with other companies. We use the same service tech (Dagner), and he is a great guy and very knowledgeable and helpful. We will continue to use Jacksonville Heating and Air

reviews.author: Richard
reviews.text: This company saved me $7,000. I had two service technicians come out from my home warranty company and they both claimed that my system had a “catastrophic failure” and needed to be replaced for $7,000. When I called Jacksonville Heating Contractors, they sent out a technician in less than 24 hours and they fixed the problem for $115 total. As a first time homeowner, I’ve experienced a good amount of companies that come out and try to screw me over, probably thinking I’m an easy target because I’m in my late 20s and new to home ownership. Jacksonville Heating Contractors sent out Jeff Owens and he was a straightforward, no-BS, friendly guy who diagnosed the problem and got it fixed on the same day. I really appreciate this company for looking out for me and not giving me the round around trying to upsell me on stuff I don’t need. Jeff Owens saved me seven grand and I couldn’t be thankful enough, if you need a great technician then I highly recommend asking for him specifically!

reviews.author: Elise Lippincott
reviews.text: Jacksonville Heating Contractors and Jermaine were top notch - arrived on time, very professional, knowledgeable and answered all my questions.

reviews.author: Erin Parr
reviews.text: Our new system is awesome. Damien, Robert and others were very professional. Very happy customer. Thank you!

reviews.author: Fritz Zeaman
reviews.text: Jeremy, Daniel and Chad were professional, efficient, competent, thorough, and resourceful. It was a pleasure to watch these fellows do the job well. Frederick Seaman PS A few days later the Jacksonville Heating Contractors roving inspector, Eric Mullis, showed up and to our surprise we found the outside unit 40 amp breaker tripped. After reset, Eric checked out the apparently OK system and eventually found a good breaker with a loose wire! Pretty work Eric! Unfortunately, many crews passed thru which i did not like because someone stole my handtruck when they were coming and going.

I will definitely be requesting his assistance for any other issues i have in the future. Amazing professionalism, I can only hope that rest of their technicians are amazing as he is.

reviews.text: Billy Buckman came out to clean our blower and evaporation coil, very nice and professional. Showed before and after pictures of what was done and made sure everything was working properly. Can really tell the difference.

reviews.author: Dave Garvey
reviews.text: Just before the beginning of summer, our 11 year old HVAC system went out on us again. I asked several friends and colleagues what AC company they would recommend and based on their recommendations, I contacted Sam Ramsey at Trent Heating & Air; a division of Jacksonville Heating Contractors. Sam was able to send out a technician on Monday to diagnosis the problem and he himself came to the house on Tuesday to discuss it with us; he came after 4:30 which goes above and beyond. That evening we decided to replace the aging/failing unit (which has been worked on by four times in the past four years by three different companies). Sam really listened to what I had to say about what we were looking for and how we wanted to install it. Sam went back to the office the next day and sent me four quotes; all ranging in cost. Once my wife and I decided on the new Trane System, Sam went into motion and ordered it and set up an install. On Memorial Day and in the pour raining, four of the most professional and courteous installers arrived early morning to install the new unit. By early afternoon we had a new up and running HVAC system. I cannot say enough positive remarks about the whole process and experience with Trent Heating and Air, which is part of Jacksonville Heating Contractors. If you are looking for a new HVAC system or a company to maintain/repair your current one, I would highly suggest Sam and this company; they are true professionals. Thank you Sam.

The Company itself is Excellent. Thank You.

reviews.text: Highly recommended. They should always be your first call for service. I contacted "H" company after my HVAC system stopped, and "H" company's technician stated, "there is nothing I can do." I was not pleased nor confident in the abilities of the "H" technician, so I contacted Jacksonville Heating Contractors. Jacksonville Heating Contractors sent, Billy, Service Technician. "CALL AN OLD FRIEND", is not just a motto on their business card, but their call to customer service.

reviews.author: Molly Malone
reviews.text: Jacksonville Heating Contractors always return my call, no matter the time or day I call. Their technician, Pete Peters, is a very knowledgeable, efficient and extremely likable man. He does excellent work and he is definitely an asset for Jacksonville Heating Contractors.

reviews.author: Monica Adams
reviews.text: Our technicians, Pete and Ray, are outstanding! They were each so friendly and thorough in their work. They answered all of our questions and we highly recommend Pete and Ray! Thanks to Jacksonville Heating Contractors for hiring the best!

reviews.author: GW Urban
reviews.text: My wife and I built a house last year, we chose Trent to provide our new main house heat pump and a mini split for the garage and bonus room. We have a service contract on all, plus we also have a service contract on another house we own. March 19, this year Trent sent out a Technician to do plan maintenance. I never turn the unit on in garage until June 18, condensation water poured out the front of the unit. I thought maybe the drain line was clogged so called Trent and a Technician came next day and told me that the drain pan was cracked in the front and that’s where water was coming from. I called Trent Havelock office and talked to the one that orders parts and expressed my concern that the Technician during the inspection must have cracked the pan, I myself never touched it and she said the boss of maintenance would look at pictures and someone would get back to me. That’s been 6 days ago, no email or call! I have had other issues with Trent and we spent a lot of money with them building our new home. At point I’m wishing I never did business with Trent and I’m leaning toward going with another company for my maintenance. Feed up! GW. Urban Beaufort, NC.

reviews.author: Grant Armstrong
reviews.text: I requested an inspection for a geothermal system. The report I got back was insufficient and didn't include items that were found by a home inspector. Don't use this service.

reviews.author: Dave Dunn
reviews.text: I could not be more thrilled with my experience. I am not one to leave reviews but outstanding service deserves to be recognized. They were able to tell me what I need, get is scheduled and replaced my hvac in a matter of days. The guys that did the work were super nice and did a wonderful job. If you want it done right with no headaches call Jacksonville Heating contractors!

reviews.author: Michael Landis
reviews.text: Fast, efficient, knowledgeable, and professional. Billy Buckman made quick work inspecting and servicing the equipment in my house to make sure my family and I would stay cool this summer. Will definitely be requesting him for any future needs

reviews.author: Michael Rogers
reviews.text: Bill did an outstanding job. My 2 year old grandson followed him everywhere.Bill was an excellent technician. After he checked everything he wrote a report that explained what he found and what he did to fix it!!

reviews.author: Robin Bell
reviews.text: Billy was very good. He explained everything and was very thorough. He showed up on time and checked everything we asked. Very good service and we will definitely use them again!!

reviews.author: Ashley Rodgers
reviews.text: They came out quickly, the technician was on time and was very professional. I felt well informed throughout the booking and had advance notice of his arrival. He kept me informed throughout the visit and was very respectful. This was hands down one of the most professional experiences I’ve had with a service company. Pete was wonderful!

reviews.author: Lauren Gardner
reviews.text: Cannot say enough good things about this company. They are responsive, knowledgeable, and reasonably priced. We lived in an older beach home and have two units so we occasionally run into issues but Jacksonville Heating Contractor’s service work is next level!

reviews.author: C Hamler
reviews.text: Degner was prompt, polite and knowledgeable.He explained everything he was doing in a way that I could easily understand it and he gave me tips on things that I could do to help keep my HVAC system running properly. I would recommend this company to anyone who has issues with their HVAC and if so, request Degner as the technician.

reviews.author: Jade Fowler
reviews.text: Brian was awesome, he was quick and efficient and he fixed multiple of our broken air conditioners that other air conditioning people have refused to touch or said they couldn't fix. Now it’s so much cooler in our store. We highly recommend this company especially Brian.

reviews.author: Scott Wicker
reviews.text: Great experience. The technician, Ray Davis arrived on time and had us up and running again within 30 minutes. Very courteous and professional.

reviews.author: Jon Crews
reviews.text: Jacksonville Heating installed my system new when building our house 7 years ago. We have a service contract with them so they come twice a year to go over everything and keep our system running smoothly!! Great service!! Eric Mullis was awesome! Very courteous and thorough and showed me everything he did. Very happy!

reviews.author: Stacey Perkins
reviews.text: Always on time - and there when I need them! I rest easy knowing Jacksonville Heating Contractors has my system running top notch - Michael is knowledgeable and friendly - HIGHLY RECOMMEND their Maintenance Membership Club!

reviews.author: Laura Blackburn
reviews.text: William/Bill was the Tech who came. He has 25 years experience and is so well educated about air conditioning and the inner workings. He quickly diagnosed the problem. But darn he does not do installs.

reviews.author: Wes Todd
reviews.text: Had this company out to my property this morning to check out an older AC unit I have. .Michael Rochelle was extremely professional and explained exactly how the system should function and made a few adjustments to get everything up and running again. Very impressed with this company and especially Michael. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Maribeth Santos
reviews.text: Billy buckman was our service technician that came by. He was quick and very informative regarding the issue. He got the job done and we are very satisfied. Thank you!

reviews.author: Martha Barcynski
reviews.text: We have had a long and great relationship with Jacksonville Heating. They installed our first system and that was 26 years ago. We have always gotten fast and excellent service. The technicians have been knowledgeable and the price is right. Thanks for taking such good care of us.

reviews.author: Larry Moye
reviews.text: Degner has been doing our service contract maintenance for the past few years. He is very helpful and knowledgeable about the units we have. He can troubleshoot a problem and have the solution quickly. We have used Jacksonville Heating Contractors for over 25 years and very happy with the service we have received!

reviews.author: Rick Crowder
reviews.text: My technician Michael did an outstanding job. He was very thorough and efficient and communicating well with me. I always get outstanding service from Jacksonville!

reviews.author: Dave Monro
reviews.text: Michael was outstanding, great communication , great knowledge and he checked and rechecked everything. Made sure we understood everything he was doing. 5 stars is not enough for him and his company. Office staff was also outstanding keeping us informed on every aspect of our repair.

reviews.author: Maximilian Alaniz
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Bill from Jacksonville Heating Contractors. He was very knowledgable and respectful. Highly recommend him and will definitely be calling back for any future needs.

reviews.author: Brooke Swart
reviews.text: Bill was extremely thorough and helpful!!! He even drew out a visual along with videos and explained in a way that I could understand. Definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: Thomas Tyska
reviews.text: Ray showed up on time and almost immediately knew the problem I was having with the heat. He got right to work and had it running right again in no time. Very professional as well as knowledgeable. Definitely left a good impression on me about this company.

reviews.author: Patrick Murray
reviews.text: Responded quick to my inquiry and fit me in same week. Great service, Reliable and fair pricing. I received 5 quotes and they came in the cheapest and went with them because they use the top of the line equipment. Would highly recommend for your heating and cooling needs.

reviews.author: Sydney Tosto
reviews.text: Called several places and Jacksonville Heating Contractors were the first ones to call back! They got me in within the same day. Ray was very helpful and honest. He fixed my issue within 30 minutes and had the part he needed in the truck. So surprised and thankful my AC was back up and running within 24 hours.

reviews.author: Billy Jenkins
reviews.text: Jacksonville Heating Contractors is a very good Heating and Air company. I would highly recommend this company to family and friends. My technician, Matthew was very thorough and nice. He explained everything that he was doing and cleaned our entire unit. The Preventive maintenance plan is well worth the money.

reviews.author: Rene Degnan
reviews.text: Awesome customer service! Matthew was our tech today. He was professional and polite. He explained and even showed us a lot about our units and how things worked. Couldn't have asked for a better experience when it comes to repair people coming to your home. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Marti Johnson
reviews.text: Professional Heating and A/C service. Tech was on time, prepared, and patient to insure unit was running correctly. Thanks for the speedy service!

reviews.author: William Dozier
reviews.text: This company and their team were excellent! They quickly diagnosed the problem and had my unit back up and running ASAP. The technician was professional, courteous and most importantly, on time……. I’m so Glad to see some companies are still fair and dependable!

reviews.author: Andy Wildwood
reviews.text: Jacksonville heating always available to help me out. been depending on them for years. Matt is great. Very thorough and took time to explain what he is doing or what I need to do to treat units correctly. Just wished they gave out data sheets with readouts like they use to so I can see how my 2 units are performing.

reviews.author: Jeff Bender
reviews.text: Very professional and knowledgeable techs. Fixed a multiple problem service call that required a lot of troubleshooting and time to repair. They always communicated and the only time waiting was for parts from Daiken. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Beth K
reviews.text: Daniel did a great job diagnosing and repairing our unit. He was considerate of my time by arriving on time for an appt that worked with my schedule. I appreciated his review of all the repairs he did in terms I could understand. Great Job!

reviews.author: Cam Kendall
reviews.text: Terrific service when our AC went out. They were out here the next week and installed everything in a few hours. Very clean install and competitive prices. Would definitely recommend these guys. Daniel and Jeremy were particularly great!

reviews.author: Kyle Compton
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Jacksonville Heating and Air. They were responsive and available for all our questions. The technicians were knowledgeable, professional, hard working and friendly. We would recommend them to family and friends and won't hesitate to call again in the future.

reviews.author: Terry Thompson
reviews.text: Needed help with an error code on my Trane unit. Called at 11am and they were there at 3 just when they said. The tech was great at troubleshooting and found a broken wire at the condensing unit within 10 minutes. Very reasonable cost. Would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Christopher Twohig
reviews.text: Daniel and Ray came out and repaired my coil system. Was professional and courteous during the whole experience and fix my problem in a timely manner. The customer service that they presented was a A+ experience. I would recommend that anyone needing ac repair or service call and schedule with this company.

reviews.author: Andrew Davis
reviews.text: Tech showed up and he was very knowledgeable and professional! I can tell he cares deeply about treating customers the right way and doing a through job! I will definitely be calling yawl back!

reviews.author: Victoria Sanders
reviews.text: I’m four months pregnant, have a 1 year old, 5 year old and 15 year old and had issues with my air conditioning. Service technician Eric Mullis came and fixed my problems and made sure everything was running correctly before he left. He provided great customer service and was polite. I will definitely be recommending him to others!

reviews.author: Tina Deaver
reviews.text: My parents had AC contractor by the name of Matthew to come to their house. They was very please with how helpful he was with his services. My father John Shepard was please with the helpful service that was conducted by Matthew in a timely manner. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sherlene Christen
reviews.text: I love it when I find out my technician will be Degner. He is always so kind and very knowledgeable. It’s good to find a company that hires quality people that actually know what they are doing.

reviews.author: Ty Gay Builders
reviews.text: Over the course of 5 years, Jacksonville has been our go to HVAC contractor for majority of our coastal built homes! Their equipment and services have been nothing short of exceptional! Would recommend to any contractor or any single individual looking for service or new installations!

reviews.author: Jonathan Snyder
reviews.text: Degner was awesome. Very polite and knowledgeable. Had another call, with Pete. The whole team is outstanding, professional, and respectful.

reviews.author: Jesse Martinez
reviews.text: The service was Amazing!!! I could not be happier since they solved a problem I was having for years. Many techs have missed this minor thing and this company found it in 15 minutes and solved the problem. I was so impressed and happy with the results and outcome. 100% I will use again!!
